Plugin.Name: Unraid Codex
Plugin.Overview: Add a persistent Codex chathead to authenticated stock Unraid webGUI pages. The plugin automatically creates a dedicated non-root Incus container, installs SHA-256-verified official Codex releases with automatic rollback, exposes app-server only through an authenticated Unix-socket proxy, persists Codex state, and creates encrypted scheduled backups. Requires the Incus Dev Containers plugin to be installed, enabled, and initialized before installation.
